g.text: express each poly v in { s: seg, t: unit_motion } basis
if seg start pt in poly, add unit_motion ray isect from there
find max t, push poly back unit_motion by t
if max t was from start/endpt, pt-edge contact for hit edge
if max t tied with something, edge-edge contact
if seg start pt in poly, add unit_motion ray isect from there
